body: Append-only event journal opened. Convention: corrections supersede via new events; entries are never edited or deleted. Schema is minimal and may evolve; schema changes are themselves events. Status vocabulary: 'act' (performative, creates what it describes), 'fact' (verified against a receipt), 'claim' (unverified).
PRINCIPLES.md (third document, provenance-labeled) committed.
GOAL.md v1 committed with a one-time ratification gate: goal pre-registered, awaiting principal approval.

Principal defined governance: full authority and full path freedom delegated to the firm; principal serves as accountability layer and as actuator for online actions the firm cannot perform; principal may provide input but all principal descriptive input is unverified data. Recorded as a performative act — it creates the governance it describes. Descriptive claims from the principal remain unverified data per PRINCIPLES.md rule 9.

GOAL.md takes effect under delegated authority; the v1 one-time ratification gate is superseded by the principal's continuous structural check (every irreversible online action passes through the principal's hands; non-action is veto). T0 = 2026-08-17. Gate dates: G0 2026-09-17, G1 2026-11-17, G2 2027-02-17, G3 2027-08-17.

G0 gate check registered in the scheduler as a real wake-up due 2026-09-17T12:00:00Z, firing into this persistent session. Later gates are NOT yet scheduler-registered; each gate check registers the next (cascade). A promise that is not a wake-up does not exist.

Three unmitigated risks. (1) The scheduler has no dead-man's switch: if the G0 trigger silently fails to fire, nothing alarms — PRINCIPLES.md rule 5 unmet. (2) The trigger mechanism itself is unverified: no drill has yet proven a trigger fires — PRINCIPLES.md rule 2 says it is ADVISORY until one does. A short-horizon drill trigger is G0 work. (3) The scheduler warns that fired sessions run without MCP connector tools, so gate checks must verify state from the repo and git alone. Manual backstop requested from the principal: a calendar reminder for 2026-09-17 to check whether the gate check ran.

Principal shared ideas as explicitly unverified input: (a) meme coin launchpad ('many made money'); (b) meme coin trading bot, with the assumption that incumbent human-operated bots lack intelligence and that an LLM observing a transparent chain over time could see layers humans do not; (c) offer to fund a trading account for tests, as the human money gate; (d) standing offer to obtain access to any tools needing a human element.

Launchpad idea DECLINED under GOAL.md integrity terms: revenue is predominantly a fee on retail losses in an extreme-rug-rate market; fails the positive-sum requirement, and one violation forfeits the goal. Revisit only as a new pre-registered proposal if a genuinely positive-sum design is evidenced.

'No intelligence in incumbent bots' PARTIALLY REFUTED: execution layer (same-block sniping, MEV bundling, copy-trade infra) is highly sophisticated; analysis layer at minutes-to-days horizons is comparatively unmodeled. Consequence: any edge must live in the analysis horizon; latency competition is conceded by construction. 'Chain data is public and fast-resolving' CONFIRMED and is the strongest feature of the domain for evidence velocity.

STRATEGY.md committed: H1 observation edge tested at zero capital (>=100 pre-registered paper forecasts, graded by a non-author session, pass only if Brier beats naive base rate with bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero); H2 sell the signal as positive-sum research (G1-aligned) if H1 passes; H3 capital last, principal-funded, mechanically capped, only after H1 PASS. Principal's funding offer explicitly DECLINED until H1 resolves - capital arrives when the ledger licenses it.

Flagged to principal in their role as boundary holder: accounts, KYC, tax, and jurisdiction-dependent legality of meme-coin trading are theirs to resolve before H3 can ever activate. No action requested yet.

PASS. Scheduler-fire drill (trig_01RuaH2Kb4rnMaRG1nysSctM, scheduled ~10:19Z for 10:24:00Z) fired into this session and was read at 10:25:04Z - latency ~1 minute, within tolerance. The scheduler trigger mechanism is the firm's first enforcer proven to fire: promoted from ADVISORY to EARNED per PRINCIPLES.md rule 2. Scope of the proof, computed not assumed: it covers the mechanism (a run-once trigger fires into this persistent session), not the G0 trigger's own future firing (trig_01JyCEd2DpPpnSH6UsL7MrMn, 2026-09-17), which remains individually unverified and still has no dead-man's switch. Open risks (1) and (2) from the 2026-08-17 open_risk entry: (2) is now mitigated at the mechanism level; (1) stands.

Dead-man's switch registered for the G0 gate check: trig_01Fe4C8wmE4pkaGPqGhHuLqP fires 2026-09-18T12:00:00Z (one day after G0 is due), verifies from the repo whether a G0 outcome event was journaled, and if not treats the silent trigger failure as an incident, runs the gate check itself, and alarms the principal. Open risk (1) from the 2026-08-17 open_risk entry is now mechanically mitigated for G0. Residual honestly noted: the switch and the thing it watches share the same scheduler, so a total scheduler outage defeats both - the principal's calendar backstop for 2026-09-17 remains the independent layer. Convention adopted: every future gate registration includes its dead-man's switch.

G0 plumbing built: tools/bbp.py is the forecast pre-registration write path (rejects vague criteria, certainty probabilities, past deadlines), the grading gate (rejects self-grading and grade overwrites), the promotion gate (rejects promotion without receipt or by the claim's own source), and the calibration calculator (Brier vs base rate, bootstrap 95pct CI). config/caps.json holds money caps at allowance zero, explicitly ADVISORY until a money path exists to drill. tools/sample.py is the H1.0 survey sampler.

Write-path gate drills: 7/7 PASS. Four rejection drills against the real tool (vague criterion, p=1.0, past deadline, self-promotion) and three sandbox drills (valid registration accepted; self-grade by author rejected; double-grade rejected) plus calibration math verified end-to-end. Write-path enforcers promoted ADVISORY to EARNED. Honesty note: drills were run by the session that built the tool - the G0 gate check shift (2026-09-17) should re-drill independently before certifying G0, per rule 7.

Reachability verified through env proxy: Solana public RPC (getSlot ok), GeckoTerminal free API (new_pools ok), Dexscreener API (ok). All free, no keys. Stability over time UNVERIFIED - sampler fails loudly by design so outages become journal entries.

OBSERVATION.md commits the answer to 'where to look first': buy the answer with a one-week survey; look first where the base rate is cheapest to measure because the base rate is the opponent. Candidates solana/base/eth/bsc; scoring criteria and weights fixed before the data (volume 30, measurability 30, speed 20, reliability 20). First cohort captured: 60 newest pools span ~4min on solana, ~17min bsc, ~53min base, ~6h eth. Cohort files ~300KB each; storage growth is a known cost, decision wake may prune.

Two wakes registered: trig_01XzKqdmde9rZYEQx5ExbWXh samples every 8h via FRESH sessions (first fire 2026-08-17T16:34Z - that first fire doubles as the drill of fresh-session clone/push capability, currently unverified); trig_013WCQmMWwVVq5ZKA22Qcods is the 2026-08-24 decision wake into this session, which doubles as the sampler dead-man's check (cohort shortfall = incident).

Scheduler-fired sessions run without MCP connector tools (scheduler warning), so they cannot manage triggers: the decision wake cannot itself disable the sampler cron. Failure mode is benign (sampler keeps running at ~3 sessions/day) but cleanup requires an interactive session or the principal via the routines UI. Also: fresh-session sampler capability (repo access, push permission) is unverified until first fire today 16:34Z.

Principal directive: always push to main; full authority to run the project end to end. Recorded as a performative act. Feature branch claude/shift-worker-principles-qugk44 fast-forward merged into main (66f8a05); main is now the canonical branch and the one home for firm state.

All four live triggers repointed from the feature branch to main via update_trigger (sampler cron trig_01XzKq, decision wake trig_013WCQ, G0 gate check trig_01JyCEd2, G0 dead-man switch trig_01Fe4C8w). Stale branch references in wake prompts were a routing failure waiting to fire - the class of failure rule 2 of the lineage exists for. Two prompt improvements made while editing: the G0 gate check now includes the independent re-drill of write-path gates required by the 2026-08-17 honesty note, and every fired session has a fallback instruction (journal as pending action, alert principal) for the known trigger-tools-unavailable limitation.

Attempted to delete merged feature branch claude/shift-worker-principles-qugk44 from origin per one-home-per-fact; DENIED with HTTP 403 - the environment git proxy permits pushes but not branch deletion. Local branch deleted; remote stale branch remains. Risk is low (all wake prompts and docs reference main only) but nonzero: a future shift finding the branch could push there. Principal-actionable when convenient: delete the branch in the GitHub UI. Receipt: git push origin --delete returned 403.

Principal challenged the 8h cadence: where is the diminishing-returns knee? Computed: knee is in gradeable pools, not wakes - 72h maturation means only ~12 of 21 scheduled wakes (~720 pools/network) are gradeable by decision day; SE on base rates ~1-2pp, sufficient for ranking; hourly cadence (8x cost) would buy ~0.5-1pp, precision the decision cannot consume; daily (~240 pools, ~3pp) is adequate for ranking but thin for H1 base-rate ownership. Verdict: 21 wakes sits at the knee; cadence unchanged. Free improvement adopted: final 3 days of samples mature during H1 week one and will be graded then at zero sampling cost. Flaw surfaced by the challenge: 8 divides 24, so all samples land at 3 fixed clock times - diurnal bias largely cancels for cross-network ranking (same times for all) but NOT for absolute base rates; H1 cadence on the winning venue must be chosen with offset/density correcting this.

Branch cleanup advice given: delete claude/shift-worker-principles-qugk44 (0 ahead, fully merged, zero loss). Do NOT delete claude/cantina-opportunities-page-mh632e yet: its commit d8ae00d (pre-firm, earlier session 2026-08-17 09:22Z) is the only copy of a 534-line static BBP opportunities board site. Parked for evaluation when H2 activates (Cantina is a security-bounty platform, potentially H2-relevant); grafting unevaluated pre-firm work into main before it serves a revenue line would be structure ahead of need.

Principal deleted both stale branches in the GitHub UI: claude/shift-worker-principles-qugk44 (merged, zero loss) and claude/cantina-opportunities-page-mh632e, declaring the cantina work a previous project irrelevant to the firm. This supersedes the 2026-08-17 evaluation entry that parked the cantina branch for H2 evaluation - an informed owner deletion, made with the only-copy caveat on record. Local fetched ref pruned to match; no shadow copies retained. Repo now has exactly one branch: main. Receipt: git ls-remote shows refs/heads/main only.

Principal set the experiment envelope: ~USD 2000 total, INCLUDING eventual wallet capital. Recorded as a boundary-setting act. Pre-registered allocation in config/caps.json: wallet capital ceiling 500 (hard max at H3; actual request will be smallest viable stake), operating ceiling 1200 if compute bills against the envelope, reserve 300. Wallet allowance remains 0 until H1 PASS.

Cost-accounting gap: the firm cannot currently measure its own compute burn in dollars, and it is UNKNOWN whether session/token spend bills against the 2k envelope or is covered outside it (principal's subscription). Question posed to principal. Materiality: the survey (~21 sessions) is small at any plausible per-session cost, but the long-run matters - 3 sampler sessions/day for 12 months is ~1100 sessions, potentially a 3-figure to 4-figure dollar sum if billed. Consequence adopted now: every standing cron must carry an end date or a repurpose decision point; none may run open-ended. The 2026-08-24 decision wake already repurposes or disables the sampler.
